input.sql:
SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS musteri_sayisi, SUM(s.order_count) AS siparis_sayisi,
       ROUND(SUM(s.total_spent)/SUM(s.order_count), 2) AS ort_sepet_siparis_agirlikli,
       ROUND(AVG(s.avg_basket), 2) AS musteri_ort_sepet_ortalamasi
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN customer_summary s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY c.gender ORDER BY c.gender

output:
gender | musteri_sayisi | siparis_sayisi | ort_sepet_siparis_agirlikli | musteri_ort_sepet_ortalamasi
E | 45432 | 4650351 | 1280.0100 | 1280.0600
K | 54566 | 5584842 | 1280.8200 | 1280.8700
(2 satır)

input.sql:
SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi, ROUND(AVG(o.total_basket), 2) AS ort_sepet
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.user_id = o.user_id
GROUP BY c.gender ORDER BY c.gender
